notes:
Simple setup, and one home for all your droids.

- Set up a droid with plain steps: found, getting ready, restarting, ready. Connection details and recovery tools stay under Help.
- Add and name multiple Meep, Boo and Claw droids. Choose one to control at a time; each remembers its own screens, brightness, orientation and quiet hours. Other powered droids keep their face or saved screens.
- A single first droid connects automatically once its model is chosen. New droids ask their model once; existing USB firmware cannot reliably identify the model by itself.
- Usage refresh timing appears beside live usage: Codex and Claude account allowance about every five minutes; Claude Code local reports every two seconds when a new report is written.
- Existing screens and settings migrate into a remembered droid profile. A settings backup is retained. Saved multi-droid profiles require 0.5.0 or newer; older apps refuse the newer settings instead of overwriting them.

Bot firmware remains 1.2.3, including powered standby. After updating the app, connect an older bot and choose Update droid if offered. Setup never flashes a newly found device without choosing setup or update.

Prerelease: Claw passed an in-app firmware update and powered standby test. Long-term USB stability, actual computer sleep and multi-droid hardware acceptance remain pending. Native package and profile tests do not establish hardware stability. Mac notarization and Windows publisher signing are not configured. Linux uses manual package updates.
